WITH insp_crit AS (
    SELECT 
        i.inspection_id,
        i.slchd_establishment_key,
        ek.name,
        i.inspection_date,
        EXTRACT(year FROM i.inspection_date) as yr,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) as critical_count
    FROM inspections i
    JOIN establishment_keys ek ON i.slchd_establishment_key = ek.slchd_establishment_key
    LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE i.inspection_date >= '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.inspection_id, i.slchd_establishment_key, ek.name, i.inspection_date
),
period_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        slchd_establishment_key,
        name,
        AVG(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN critical_count END) as avg_early_crit,
        AVG(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN critical_count END) as avg_late_crit,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN 1 END) as count_early,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN 1 END) as count_late
    FROM insp_crit
    GROUP BY slchd_establishment_key, name
)
SELECT 
    name,
    slchd_establishment_key,
    ROUND(avg_early_crit, 2) as avg_early,
    ROUND(avg_late_crit, 2) as avg_late,
    ROUND(avg_late_crit - avg_early_crit, 2) as change_in_crit
FROM period_stats
WHERE count_early >= 1 AND count_late >= 1
ORDER BY change_in_crit DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH insp_crit AS (
    SELECT 
        i.inspection_id,
        i.slchd_establishment_key,
        ek.name,
        i.inspection_date,
        EXTRACT(year FROM i.inspection_date) as yr,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) as critical_count
    FROM inspections i
    JOIN establishment_keys ek ON i.slchd_establishment_key = ek.slchd_establishment_key
    LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE i.inspection_date >= '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.inspection_id, i.slchd_establishment_key, ek.name, i.inspection_date
),
period_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        slchd_establishment_key,
        name,
        AVG(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN critical_count END) as avg_early,
        AVG(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN critical_count END) as avg_late,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN 1 END) as cnt_early,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN 1 END) as cnt_late
    FROM insp_crit
    GROUP BY slchd_establishment_key, name
    HAVING cnt_early >= 1 AND cnt_late >= 1
),
classified AS (
    SELECT 
        slchd_establishment_key,
        name,
        avg_early,
        avg_late,
        ROUND(avg_late - avg_early, 2) as diff,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg_late > avg_early THEN 'Increased'
            WHEN avg_late < avg_early THEN 'Decreased'
            ELSE 'Unchanged'
        END as trend
    FROM period_stats
)
SELECT 
    trend,
    COUNT(*) as num_restaurants,
    ROUND(AVG(diff), 2) as avg_change
FROM classified
GROUP BY trend
ORDER BY num_restaurants DESC

WITH insp_crit AS (
    SELECT 
        i.inspection_id,

        COUNT(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 END) as critical_count

    LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
    WHERE i.inspection_date >= '2021-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.inspection_id, i.slchd_establishment_key, i.inspection_date
),
period_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        slchd_establishment_key,
        AVG(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN critical_count END) as avg_early,
        AVG(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 THEN critical_count END) as avg_late,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN yr BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023 THEN 1 END) as cnt_early,
